audience.en: Helen and her husband, Melbourne-based travellers planning a manual-wheelchair Kansai trip; also useful to Chinese-speaking wheelchair travellers without changing the original profile or eligibility.

localeReason: English and Simplified Chinese are genuinely useful for Chinese-speaking wheelchair travellers planning Kansai. Translation retains Helen, age 58 at research, Melbourne residence, full-time manual-wheelchair use and brief standing transfers, husband and Australian insurance context. No citizenship/passport is invented, and foreign-passport/Temporary Visitor ticket eligibility is conditional rather than transferred to other readers.

provenance.sourceAccessMethod: README and adjacent VOICE-GUIDE first; batch35 Perth JSON and English Markdown for schema/voice only. Complete assigned index.html, sources.md and independent-check.md read. No other factual run, external lookup, contact, publication or inventory/build edits. Package content_utils.py/check_i18n.py inspected for scoped authoring checks.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Some original automatic fetch/search routes used managed-browser sessions, including relied-on supplementary Marriott/Moxy overviews. Clean-session history cannot be certified; no new source refresh or cure is claimed. Four main hotels and insurers had direct preserved evidence.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: Original independent check passed arithmetic/ledger traceability, not booking readiness, future affordability, full primary re-verification or clean-session compliance. It independently recomputed 15 budget rows; several repeat primary fetches failed and were not counted as successful. Original visual/layout history is not evidence for these new Markdown files.
provenance.layoutEvidenceLimit: No HTML build, browser, visual, accessibility or print checks performed for these authored files.

datePolicy: All cited-source access dates retain 2026-11-07 from the assigned ledger. Historical prices, policy issue dates, old survey dates and future travel remain separate. Authoring is not source refresh. Unknown model/publication date remains unknown.
